note: The rules a dwelling's layout keeps, beyond the contract's (levels/assembly/README.md): few, each from a published source or from a fault the person found walking a map in the game. Sizes are not written here: each kind names the kind of levels/rules/architecture.json it is measured as, and levels/assembly/style.mjs turns that kind's metres into cells of 64 by the GoldSrc hull (0.0254 m a unit), least sizes rounded up, greatest down. A rule is added only with a failure in the game or a source to show for it.

sources.neufert: E. and P. Neufert, Architects' Data; scaled to the games in architecture.json (scale)
sources.alexander: C. Alexander et al., A Pattern Language (OUP 1977); patterns by number
sources.walk-2026-11-02: the person's walk of smak_house01 in Half-Life on 2026-11-02 (PLAN.md, 'First walk in game'): the living room narrow, the kitchen in the middle of the house

area.says: a room's cells are within its kind's area (minArea to maxArea of architecture.json, in cells)

minSide.says: the largest rectangle inside a room is at least its kind's minSide across, in cells (and 2, the depth a door's leaf swings into)

compact.says: the largest rectangle inside a room holds at least this share of its cells: a room is a rectangle with at most a bay, not an L of two thin arms; a hall or a landing (zone circulation) is not held to it, as it wraps round the stair

window.says: a room of these kinds has a window on an outside wall (architecture.json roomNeeds.window; patterns 159, 180)

lightTwoSides.says: the living room has windows on two sides of it (pattern 159, light on two sides of every room, where the footprint allows)

gradient.says: every room is reached from the entrance without passing through a private room (zone private) or an end (a bathroom), except the pairs [through, room] listed (patterns 127 intimacy gradient, 136 couple's realm)

entranceRoom.says: the entrance opens into one of these kinds (architecture.json programs.house.entrance, with the hall)

front.says: the entrance stands on the front wall, and the kitchen stands deeper from the front than the living room (pattern 127: the common rooms at the door, the kitchen further in; the kitchen in the middle of the house was the walk's fault)

doors.says: with doors "auto": every room of a storey opens off that storey's circulation room (the hall, the landing), and the pairs listed are joined as well (pattern 139, farmhouse kitchen: the kitchen opens on the living room)
